package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub struct {
	reserve                                                   []domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve
	getStudent, getInstance                                   string
	openStudent, openInstance, openAction                     string
	cancelStudent, cancelInstance, cancelAction, cancelReason string
	openAt, cancelAt                                          time.Time
	result                                                    domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding
	err                                                       error
}

func (stub *practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub) ReservePracticeLearningAction(_ context.Context, input domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error) {
	stub.reserve = append(stub.reserve, input)
	return stub.result, len(stub.reserve) > 1, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub) GetPracticeLearningAction(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	stub.getStudent, stub.getInstance = studentID, instanceID
	return stub.result, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub) OpenPracticeLearningAction(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID, actionID string, now time.Time) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error) {
	stub.openStudent, stub.openInstance, stub.openAction = studentID, instanceID, actionID
	stub.openAt = now
	return stub.result, false, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub) CancelPracticeLearningAction(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID, actionID, reason string, now time.Time) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error) {
	stub.cancelStudent, stub.cancelInstance, stub.cancelAction = studentID, instanceID, actionID
	stub.cancelReason = reason
	stub.cancelAt = now
	return stub.result, false, stub.err
}

type practiceLearningActionIDStub struct {
	ids   []string
	index int
}

type practiceLearningEvidenceRepositoryStub struct {
	evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2
	closedAt time.Time
	accepted bool
	err      error
}

func (stub *practiceLearningEvidenceRepositoryStub) ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(_ context.Context, evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
	stub.evidence, stub.closedAt = evidence, closedAt
	return stub.accepted, stub.err
}

func (stub *practiceLearningActionIDStub) NewID() string {
	value := stub.ids[stub.index]
	stub.index++
	return value
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionsReserveDelegatesCanonicalTimestampAndReplayIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("UTC+3", 3*3600))
	repository := &practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub{}
	ids := &practiceLearningActionIDStub{ids: []string{"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}}
	useCase := PracticeLearningActions{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}, IDs: ids}
	input := domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", IdempotencyKey: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", SurfaceClassification: "practice",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}}
	if _, err := useCase.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(repository.reserve) != 2 || repository.reserve[0].LearningActionID != ids.ids[0] || repository.reserve[1].LearningActionID != ids.ids[1] ||
		repository.reserve[0].EnsureRequestHash != repository.reserve[1].EnsureRequestHash || !repository.reserve[0].OccurredAt.Equal(now.UTC()) {
		t.Fatalf("reserve delegation=%+v", repository.reserve)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionsReservePreservesRuntimeSuppliedLearningActionID(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub{}
	ids := &practiceLearningActionIDStub{ids: []string{"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"}}
	useCase := PracticeLearningActions{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}, IDs: ids}
	requestedID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	input := domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", TaskInstanceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LearningActionID: requestedID,
		IdempotencyKey:     "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", SurfaceClassification: "practice",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}}
	if _, err := useCase.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(repository.reserve) != 1 || repository.reserve[0].LearningActionID != requestedID || ids.index != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("runtime-supplied learning action identity was replaced: input=%+v generated=%d", repository.reserve, ids.index)
	}
	input.LearningActionID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	if _, err := useCase.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if repository.reserve[0].EnsureRequestHash == repository.reserve[1].EnsureRequestHash {
		t.Fatal("changing an explicitly supplied learning action ID did not change reservation idempotency")
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionsRejectUppercaseTransitionIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := PracticeLearningActions{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now()}}
	_, err := useCase.Open(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-33333333333A")
	if err == nil || repository.openAction != "" {
		t.Fatalf("uppercase action ID must not reach repository: err=%v action=%q", err, repository.openAction)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Get(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-11111111111A", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"); err == nil || repository.getStudent != "" {
		t.Fatal("uppercase student ID must not reach Practice GET repository")
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Cancel(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-33333333333A", domain.PracticeLearningActionCancelReason); err == nil || repository.cancelAction != "" {
		t.Fatal("uppercase action ID must not reach Practice cancel repository")
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionsUseUTCTransitionTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("UTC+5", 5*3600))
	repository := &practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := PracticeLearningActions{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}
	studentID, instanceID, actionID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	if _, err := useCase.Open(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, actionID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Cancel(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, actionID, domain.PracticeLearningActionCancelReason); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !repository.openAt.Equal(now.UTC()) || !repository.cancelAt.Equal(now.UTC()) || repository.openAt.Location() != time.UTC || repository.cancelAt.Location() != time.UTC {
		t.Fatalf("transition timestamps are not normalized: open=%s cancel=%s", repository.openAt, repository.cancelAt)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionsCancelPassesReasonAndRejectsUnknownReason(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &practiceLearningActionRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := PracticeLearningActions{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now().UTC()}}
	studentID, instanceID, actionID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	if _, err := useCase.Cancel(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, actionID, "student_cancelled"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("student cancellation failed: %v", err)
	}
	if repository.cancelReason != "student_cancelled" || repository.cancelAction != actionID {
		t.Fatalf("cancel request not passed through: reason=%q action=%q", repository.cancelReason, repository.cancelAction)
	}
	repository.cancelReason, repository.cancelAction = "", ""
	if _, err := useCase.Cancel(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, actionID, "unexpected"); err == nil || repository.cancelAction != "" {
		t.Fatalf("unknown reason reached repository: err=%v reason=%q action=%q", err, repository.cancelReason, repository.cancelAction)
	}
}

func TestApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidenceUsesServerCloseTimeAndStrictURLBinding(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("UTC+5", 5*3600))
	studentID, instanceID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	input := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2,
		EvidenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", LearningActionID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: instanceID, TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		SubmissionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
		Evidence:   []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{"implement"}}},
		OccurredAt: time.Now(), PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2}
	repository := &practiceLearningEvidenceRepositoryStub{accepted: true}
	useCase := ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence{Actions: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}
	receipt, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input)
	if err != nil || receipt.Schema != domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV2 || !receipt.Accepted || !repository.closedAt.Equal(now.UTC()) || repository.evidence.LearningActionID != input.LearningActionID {
		t.Fatalf("receipt=%+v stored=%+v closed=%s err=%v", receipt, repository.evidence, repository.closedAt, err)
	}
	repository.accepted = false // repository reports an exact committed replay.
	replay, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input)
	if err != nil || replay != receipt {
		t.Fatalf("replay receipt must be stable: replay=%+v receipt=%+v err=%v", replay, receipt, err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-33333333333A", input.EvidenceID, input); err == nil || repository.evidence.TaskInstanceID != instanceID {
		t.Fatalf("noncanonical URL instance must not reach repository: err=%v evidence=%+v", err, repository.evidence)
	}
}
